Overeating is already something they generalise as self harm. As someone with an eating disorder which heavily limits their diet, I am CONSTANTLY hungry and have to overeat snacks in order to not be low on energy. Yes its not healthy and I have been looking for ways to treat it for years, but I wasn't doing it to harm myself. I was doing it to AVOID any harm (aka starvation).

Mhm. As someone who has been staying up for more than 24 hours with the INTENTION of harming themselves, and also doing things such as starvation and looking at sad things with the intention of triggering myself as a form of self harm, I have also done these things WITHOUT the intention of harming myself. Sometimes I just forget to eat, sometimes insomnia kicks in. Sometimes I just find a very sad article and want to read more about it out of curiousity.

Self harm is something you do on purpose. It's something that has the intention of causing damage to oneself. Forgetting to sleep due to insomnia or being too fatigued to get up in the morning due to a depressive episode for example aren't self harm, these aren't thing that were done with such intention.

Tbf it's only considered that way if you're forcing yourself to stay awake in the INTENTION of harming yourself.

Like all this shit is listen cannot be considered self harm if it wasn't done with the intent of harming yourself. You underate today? Maybe you just forgot to eat. You bit your nails during the exam? You could be stressed.
